annotations.title: Weather now, last days and 48-hour forecast in Belgium (KMI/IRM)

description: The weather at an address or point in Belgium from the Royal Meteorological Institute (KMI/IRM) open data: what the nearest synoptic station measures now (temperature, wind and gusts, humidity, cloud cover, pressure), its last 24 hours (minimum, maximum, precipitation), the last 7 days at the nearest automatic station (daily rain, max/min, sunshine), and KMI's ALARO model forecast for that point for the next 48 hours (3-hourly for the first day: temperature, precipitation, snow, wind, gusts, cloud cover) with 24-hour summaries and when rain is first expected, plus KMI's official weather warnings (yellow, orange, red for wind, rain, snow and ice, thunderstorms, fog, heat, cold, the coast) in force or announced for that place's province and, at the coast, the coastal zone, read live from KMI's feed on EUMETNET MeteoAlarm with the original warning text. Starts with key_facts (a warning comes first). Observations come from a station up to tens of km away; the forecast is a single deterministic model run without probabilities. Does not give climate normals, rain radar or forecasts beyond about 60 hours. Examples: What is the weather in Leuven now, and will it rain tomorrow? → {"address":"Grote Markt 1, 3000 Leuven"}; Weather forecast for Liège for the next two days → {"address":"Place Saint-Lambert 1, 4000 Liège"}; How windy is it at the coast in Ostend, and is there a storm warning? → {"latitude":51.2194,"longitude":2.9269}.

address.description: Address or place in Belgium, e.g. 'Grote Markt 1, 3000 Leuven' or 'Place Saint-Lambert 1, 4000 Liège'.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude, e.g. 51.0453 (use with longitude instead of address).

x_lambert72.description: Belgian Lambert 72 (EPSG:31370) x in metres, as an alternative to latitude/longitude.
